vulnerability_cn: LP 单独转入交易池后被第三方调用 burn 赎回
vulnerability_en: Third-party redemption of LP tokens transferred separately to the pair
detail_cn: LP 持有人把加池所得 LP 单独转给池子，公开 burn(to) 使用池子自身 LP 余额并向调用者指定的接收方赎回。链上主提款交易0x4e9f…转出1603.99 WBNB；源表0x939f…是同区块较晚且无事件的关联调用。现有证据支持 LP 操作风险，不支持把约95万美元归为该较晚交易的储备操纵收益。源表损失保留949900美元；最终接收方WBNB流入约32.08，未等同全程净利。
detail_en: The LP holder separately transferred liquidity tokens to the pair. Public burn(to) redeemed the pair-held LP balance to a caller-selected recipient. The independently verified funds-out transaction 0x4e9f… removed 1603.99 WBNB; the sheet transaction 0x939f… is a later call in the same block with no logs. Evidence supports unsafe LP handling, not a USD 950k reserve-manipulation profit in the later transaction. The sheet loss remains USD 949900; the final receiver received about 32.08 WBNB, not established campaign net profit.
source_verification: Successful setup, LP-transfer and burn receipts verified. Original reference PancakePair source matches the entire target runtime at latest; target has no direct Sourcify match. Historical runtime and debug trace unavailable; ATM token original source not recovered. Pair is the affected redemption surface, not a confirmed defect in standard PancakeSwap code. No local fork replay.
